LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_DragonianBloodline.label: (Raven) Dragonian Bloodline (Minor)
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_DragonianBloodline.descript:
An ancient bloodline from the Dragonian race. It grants a robust physique, remarkable regeneration, and overwhelming strength.

Stat bonuses:
- Wound healing speed +300% (4.0x total)
- Melee damage +30%
- Melee hit chance +5
- Move speed +0.8
- Incoming damage -15% (dragon scale protection)
